Watch: Look for opportunities to reduce exposure on your deeply underwater leveraged positions if the tech rally provides a bounce. Monitor geopolitical developments for market shifts.

Bottom line: Use any tech strength to aggressively manage risk on your most damaged leveraged positions; capital preservation is key right now.
plays: Trim CRWD to lock in profits and reduce overall portfolio risk.
Consider reducing exposure to SOXL and MUU on any strength; your -78.17% and -61.79% losses on leveraged ETFs are critical.
Consider ANET long if it hits scanner entry 184.9-184.45, with a stop at 182.91, given the positive tech sentiment.
